This repository is the long-running project to make Shaan's Claude Code and Codex agent
setup produce more useful work per token. Astra (the owner) defines the desired outcome,
approach, constraints and acceptance; one context-clean Luna run performs substantial
implementation, tests and routine fixes until Astra accepts the result. The setup itself
lives in `~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, and `SISO_Agents/siso-harness-lab/brain`; this repo holds the evidence,
the decisions, the backlog, and the tools to measure.

## The agent stack and its owner

Shaan, 23 Sep: "you should actually be the owner of a project and have all your memory … there". This repo is
the agent stack project: how every agent on his machines works (brain and estate router, hooks, skills, project
memory, DeepSeek workers). No standing owner since 4 Oct: Agent Zero (`SISO_Agents/agent-zero/siso-agent-zero`) changes it
through jobs, and the rules for that are its `PRINCIPLES.md` and skill `deletion-pass` (count, playbook, ledger).

- **Memory:** `.agents/memory/MEMORY.md`, read first; the agent-stack facts live there.
- **The page:** `python3 scripts/stack-page.py --post` rebuilds it from live data at http://127.0.0.1:8891/card/agent-stack/html.
- **History retention:** `docs/HISTORY-RETENTION.md`. **Restructure:** lanes in
  `~/SISO_Workspace/docs/operations/restructure-2026-09-23/COORDINATION.md`.

## Start here (conditional)

For a direct assignment, read the nearest applicable instructions and the files named by
the assignment, then implement the requested outcome. Do not override the current task with
an historical budget phase or replay a completed experiment. For a backlog or recursive
efficiency assignment, read `STATE.md`, `BACKLOG.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `docs/method.md`, and
only the report named by the selected item; use `.agents/PAGE.md` and
`docs/IMPROVEMENT-LOOP.md` when that loop is explicitly in scope. Web UI work follows
`docs/WEB-UI-PICKUP.md` only when the assignment is a Web UI pickup.

For an assigned Luna run, read the authoritative packet at
`/Users/shaansisodia/.codex/task-inbox/<task_name>.md` before implementation when that
adapter route is actually used. Verify its receipt and model; do not blind-retry a missing
packet. Native plaintext routes do not need this workaround.

When the local console is available, post one material-start card. A Web UI or
other remote agent records its claim in `.agents/HANDOFF.md` instead; missing
laptop services are not a reason to stop portable repository work.

## Invariants

- **Measure first, change second, measure again.** Every change carries a before/after
  number or a probe with a payload. `scripts/probe-turn1.sh` and `scripts/audit.py` are the
  instruments. A green syntax check is not evidence.
- **Every removal is restorable.** Back up to `~/.claude/backups/<run>/` and append one line
  to that run's `MANIFEST.txt` before deleting or rewriting anything under `~/.claude`,
  `~/.codex`, or the brain.
- **Generated files have sources.** `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`
  come from `SISO_Agents/siso-harness-lab/brain/` (core + `estate.md` + shell) via `compose-brain.mjs`. Edit the
  source, recompose; `--check` also fails when the estate router names a missing skill or path.
- **No context-size hooks. Nothing scheduled.** See `DECISIONS.md`. These have been ruled on.
- **Never commit `~/.claude`.** This repo is where the record lives.
- **Verify a producer/consumer pair by running both halves** and listing what exists on
  disk. Two of the worst bugs found here (console inbox filename, stale checkpoint mtime)
  passed one-sided checks for weeks.
- **Attribute a rollout by its model field, never by substring.** See lessons ledger.
- **A Luna run may implement, test and repair files explicitly in its brief.** Preserve
  unrelated edits; before rewriting an existing file, make the task-scoped backup required
  by the brief. Astra reviews the diff and acceptance evidence when Luna returns.
- **Helpers are selective, not a quota.** Dispatch a helper only for a genuinely separable
  task whose result earns its setup/review cost; never manufacture work or run an automatic
  fleet. Cheap tiny operations can stay inline, while consequential judgment remains Astra.

## Operating contract

Astra supplies the outcome, approach, constraints, acceptance test and stop/safety gates.
Luna owns the substantial execution loop: inspect targeted source, implement the smallest
correct change, run relevant checks, fix routine failures, and return a compact receipt with
changed paths, checks and limitations. Luna should continue through ordinary implementation
and test failures; stop only for a genuine decision blocker, safety boundary, missing
authority/input, or acceptance ambiguity. The owner does not micromanage or poll routine
progress. This contract is not an 80% token quota, a forced delegation rule for one-line
work, automatic scheduling, or a global configuration change.

## Close-out

Before ending a session here: update `STATE.md` (prepend a dated entry), move finished
backlog items to `BACKLOG.md § Done` with the evidence path, commit this repo with a
message that names the run, and post a console card. For a delegated subtask, the parent
owner performs those repository close-out writes and the final commit. If ~/.claude changed,
the manifest line is already written (see invariants).
